items.title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overshoots Runway, Closing Miami Airport
items.content: An Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and burst into flames on Sunday, shutting down the airport’s runways and taxiways and prompting an emergency response. This video has been updated to include additional footage. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Japan’s Nikkei Gains as Tech Tailwinds Help Balance Macro Nerves
items.content: Japan’s Nikkei 225 climbed as tech stocks followed their US peers higher after Friday’s rally. Gains on the broader Topix were smaller as concerns about the yen and bond yields limited risk appetite.

items.title: Australia’s AI Boom Risks Demand Surge and Higher Rates, BE Says
items.content: Australia’s data center boom risks pushing demand beyond the economy’s supply capacity, fueling inflation and requiring the Reserve Bank to run higher interest rates, according to James McIntyre at Bloomberg Economics.

items.title: Goldman-Backed Taxi App Says Ridership Good Despite Fare Hikes
items.content: Go Inc., the taxi booking app operator that pulled off Japan’s biggest initial public offering this year, said it is sustaining strong ride volume even after fare hikes.

items.title: Nigeria’s Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Exit From Country
items.content: Nigeria’s antitrust commission said it is probing Uber Technologies Inc.’s abrupt exit from the West African nation, after the ride-hailing platform shut down last week without prior notice to users.
